plugins.name: abp-sensei
plugins.description: Expert ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6, .NET 10) companion for Claude Code: 26 production-grounded skills, a specialized ABP architect subagent that detects your solution's ABP version and adapts, and slash commands for entity scaffolding, code review, CRUD generation, and upgrade audits. Covers DDD, EF Core/MongoDB, multi-tenancy, modularity, authorization, microservices, and more.

skills.name: abp-ai
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) AI integration: Microsoft.Extensions.AI (IChatClient), Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, AI Workspaces, AI Management module (Pro) with RAG, document indexing/chunking and MCP servers. Use when you need chat clients, AI agents, RAG or AI workspace management in ABP.
headings: AI Management Module (Pro — Team license or higher)
skills.description_zh: 在 ABP Framework 10.4—10.6 中集成聊天客户端、AI 智能体、Semantic Kernel、AI 工作区、RAG、文档索引分块和 MCP 服务。

skills.name: abp-api
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) API development: Auto API Controllers, dynamic and static C#/JS client proxies, Swagger, API versioning, Integration Services. Use when you need a REST API, controller, dynamic proxy or client generation in ABP.
skills.description_zh: 在 ABP Framework 10.4—10.6 中开发 REST API，配置自动控制器、C# 与 JavaScript 客户端代理、Swagger、API 版本和集成服务。

skills.name: abp-audit-logging
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) audit logging: AbpAuditingOptions, entity history, IAuditingStore, audit log storage and filtering. Use when configuring audit trails, audit logs, or entity history in ABP.
skills.description_zh: 在 ABP Framework 10.4—10.6 中配置审计选项、实体历史、审计存储、日志过滤和审计追踪。

skills.name: abp-authorization
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) authorization: defining permissions (PermissionDefinitionProvider), [Authorize], CheckPolicyAsync/IsGrantedAsync, CurrentUser, IPermissionManager, resource-based auth, multi-tenancy permissions. Use when you need permission, role or access checks in ABP.
headings: Changing Permission Definitions of Dependent Modules
skills.description_zh: 在 ABP Framework 10.4—10.6 中定义并检查权限，处理角色、当前用户、资源授权和多租户访问控制。

skills.name: abp-cli
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) CLI and tooling: abp new, add-package, generate-proxy, ABP Studio, ABP Suite, --modern flag. Use when working with ABP CLI commands, creating projects, adding packages, or generating proxies.
skills.description_zh: 使用 ABP Framework 10.4—10.6 的命令行工具、ABP Studio 和 ABP Suite 创建项目、添加包和生成客户端代理。

skills.name: abp-dapr
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) Dapr integration: Volo.Abp.Dapr packages, service invocation via C# API client proxies (Volo.Abp.Http.Client.Dapr), distributed event bus over Dapr pub/sub (Volo.Abp.EventBus.Dapr + Volo.Abp.AspNetCore.Mvc.Dapr.EventBus), distributed lock, AbpDaprOptions, API token security. Use when you need Dapr sidecar communication, Dapr pub/sub, or Dapr service invocation in ABP.
headings: Service Invocation — C# API Client Proxies over Dapr
Distributed Event Bus over Dapr Pub/Sub
skills.description_zh: 在 ABP Framework 10.4—10.6 中配置 Dapr 服务调用、发布订阅事件总线、分布式锁、侧车通信和 API 令牌安全。

skills.name: abp-ddd
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) Domain Driven Design: Entity, AggregateRoot, repository, domain service, application service, DTO, domain events (AddLocalEvent/AddDistributedEvent), specification, value object, UOW. Use when designing the domain layer, entities, aggregates, or repositories in ABP.
skills.description_zh: 在 ABP Framework 10.4—10.6 中设计领域层、实体、聚合、仓储、领域与应用服务、领域事件、值对象和工作单元。

skills.name: abp-dependency-injection
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) dependency injection: ITransientDependency/IScopedDependency/ISingletonDependency, [Dependency], [ExposeServices], LazyServiceProvider, property injection, Autofac. Use when you need service registration, DI, or automatic registration in ABP.
skills.description_zh: 在 ABP Framework 10.4—10.6 中配置依赖注入、服务生命周期、自动注册、属性注入、延迟服务和 Autofac。

skills.name: abp-dependency-rules
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) layer dependency rules: layer direction (Domain.Shared→Domain→Application.Contracts→Application→HttpApi→Host), project reference matrix, anti-patterns (no DbContext in Application, don't expose IQueryable, don't return entity as DTO). Use when you need project/layer architecture or dependency rules in ABP.
skills.description_zh: 为 ABP Framework 10.4—10.6 项目确定层次依赖方向和项目引用规则，避免应用层直接使用 DbContext、暴露 IQueryable 或将实体当作 DTO 返回。

skills.name: abp-deployment
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) deployment: production config, clustered/stateless design, distributed cache (Redis), BLOB provider selection, distributed lock, SignalR backplane, ForwardedHeaders (reverse proxy), SSL/HTTPS, OpenIddict production certificates, Docker/Kubernetes (Helm). Use when you need to deploy an ABP application to production or containerize it.

skills.name: abp-development-flow
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) development flow: adding a new entity end-to-end (Domain → Domain.Shared → repository → EF Core config → migration → Contracts/DTO → object mapping → app service → localization → permission → test). Use when you need the flow for adding a new feature in ABP.
headings: 3. Repository Interface (optional — only if a custom query is needed, `*.Domain/`)

skills.name: abp-efcore
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) Entity Framework Core: AbpDbContext, ConfigureByConvention, AddAbpDbContext, repository (EfCoreRepository), migration, PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite/Oracle. Use when working with EF Core, DbContext, migrations, or repository implementation in ABP.
headings: Choosing a DBMS with the CLI

skills.name: abp-exception-handling
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) exception handling: BusinessException, UserFriendlyException, RemoteServiceErrorResponse, HTTP status mapping, error code localization. Use for error handling in ABP, when you need a business exception or an HTTP error response.

skills.name: abp-framework
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) core guide: solution templates (app, app-nolayers, microservice), layered architecture, module system, base classes (ApplicationService/DomainService), Clock/GuidGenerator/CurrentUser/LazyServiceProvider, .NET 10. Use when creating an ABP project, or when architecture or core conventions are needed.

skills.name: abp-infrastructure
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) infrastructure: Distributed Event Bus, Background Jobs/Workers, Caching (Redis), BLOB Storing, Emailing, SignalR, IClock, Distributed Locking, Entity Cache. Use when you need an event bus, background job, cache, blob or email in ABP.

skills.name: abp-localization
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) localization: localization resource, JSON files, culture fallback, L[] helper, IStringLocalizer. Use for multi-language, localization, or translation in ABP.

skills.name: abp-microservices
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) microservice solution: structure (apps/gateways/services), Integration Services [IntegrationService], distributed events (RabbitMQ Outbox/Inbox), YARP gateway, OpenIddict auth server, Entity Cache, database-per-service. Use when you need microservices or inter-service communication in ABP.
headings: 5. Consumer — register the HTTP client proxy

skills.name: abp-modularity
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) modularity: AbpModule, [DependsOn], module lifecycle, plugin modules, modular monolith. Use when creating a module, defining module dependencies, or building a modular architecture in ABP.
headings: Creating a Module with the CLI

skills.name: abp-modules
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) pre-built application modules: Identity, Account, OpenIddict, Tenant/Permission/Setting/Feature Management, Audit Logging, CMS Kit, SaaS, Payment and more — which module solves what, how to install it, free vs Pro. Use when choosing, installing, or extending a pre-built ABP module (abp add-module) in an ABP application.
headings: Include a module's source code in your solution for deep customization
Adding a module with the CLI
Pro modules (require ABP Team or higher license)

skills.name: abp-mongodb
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) MongoDB: AbpMongoDbContext, collection mapping, index, transaction, replica set, repository. Use when working with MongoDB, document databases, or MongoDB repositories in ABP.

skills.name: abp-multitenancy
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) multi-tenancy: tenant resolver, ICurrentTenant, IMultiTenant, database isolation, tenant-based data filtering. Use when working with SaaS, multi-tenancy, or tenant management in ABP.
headings: Data Filtering — Disabling the Multi-Tenancy Filter

skills.name: abp-object-mapping
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) object mapping: IObjectMapper, Mapperly (default since v10.4, MapperBase), AutoMapper profiles, entity↔DTO conversion, AutoMap attributes. Use when you need object mapping or DTO mapping in ABP.

skills.name: abp-settings-features
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) settings and features: ISettingProvider/ISettingManager, SettingDefinitionProvider, IFeatureChecker, feature toggle. Use for configuration management, settings, or feature flags in ABP.
headings: Changing Setting Definitions of a Dependent Module

skills.name: abp-testing
skills.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) testing: integration tests, *TestBase classes (Domain/Application/EntityFrameworkCore), SQLite in-memory, Shouldly, NSubstitute, data seeding, CurrentUser/CurrentTenant.Change, AddAlwaysAllowAuthorization. Use when you need to write unit/integration tests in ABP.
headings: Testing with a Specific User / Tenant

commands.name: crud
commands.description: Generate an ABP CrudAppService (or ICrudAppService implementation) with DTOs and permissions for an existing aggregate, ABP v10.x style.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain an ABP Framework v10.x (10.4–10.6) concept or API clearly, grounded in the bundled skills, with a minimal idiomatic code example.

commands.name: new-entity
commands.description: Scaffold a complete ABP DDD entity end-to-end (domain → contracts → application service → EF Core mapping + migration → permissions → integration test) for ABP v10.x / .NET 10.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review code or the current diff against ABP Framework v10.x best practices — layering, dependency rules, DDD, async, security, and deprecated APIs.

commands.name: upgrade-audit
commands.description: Audit an ABP solution for readiness against the latest stable ABP (v10.6) / .NET 10 — deprecated APIs, outdated packages, auth migration, and configuration drift.
